correctness.rationale: C PASS. For F_b(x)=bx-sgn x on (-1,1), b in (1,2), the two positive-slope branch images partially overlap: density is 1/(2b) outside overlap and 1/b within it, so uniform input is not uniform output; endpoints b=1 (partition) and b=2 (double cover) preserve normalized Lebesgue. Hence genuinely alternating uniform-gain pairs are (2,1),(1,2). With A=F2 and B=F1, almost everywhere B²=id, A∘B=A and A=id+B. The phase-two system reduces to signed dyadic doubling; transfer P_A x=x/2, and E[x²]=1/3 determine all exact phase covariances and their opposite lag-two signs. The paired sum S_m=sum_{j=1}^m A^j(W), W=A(U), has covariance 1/(3*2^k), variance m-4/3+4/(3*2^m), and differs by <=2 from sum of independent fair binary digits, giving standard CLT. Independent deterministic midpoint integration 2^18 subdivisions confirmed eight even/odd correlations and four block variances; algebra and Bernoulli coding prove all lags and weak convergence. Threshold preimages are null, distinct gains, range [1,2].
